messages.text: Morning all. Quick heads-up: 4.12 is still scheduled for Thursday 10/23. Please post blockers here instead of in DMs so we have one place to look.
Morning. One potential blocker: the invoice_line_items migration timed out on staging-eu last night. It ran 38 minutes before the lock timeout killed it.
Confirmed, I saw the same on staging-us around 2am. Small tenants were fine, it's the ones with more than 2M rows.
How many prod tenants are over 2M rows?
14 in prod. Acme Freight is the biggest at roughly 11M.
If that runs in prod with the same lock it blocks invoice writes for those tenants for the whole run. That's a no-go for a daytime deploy.
I can rewrite it as a batched backfill (50k rows per batch) behind a feature flag. About a day of work.
Do it. Marcus owns the migration rewrite, target is a PR up by Tuesday noon.
Switching topics, sorry. Acme Freight just opened a P1: their AP team sees duplicate invoices for October, 37 so far. Their controller has cc'd their VP of Finance.
Is that related to the webhook retry change that shipped in 4.11.2?
Possibly. 4.11.2 changed the retry backoff for invoice.created webhooks. If their endpoint returned a 500 after accepting the payload, we'd resend and they'd create a second invoice on their side.
They're saying the duplicates show up in OUR UI, not in their ERP. Screenshot from their controller attached.

Found it. The duplicates all share the same idempotency key but have different created_at values about 2s apart. Looks like the retry worker doesn't check the key while the first write is still in flight.
@Alex Wong you wrote the idempotency middleware originally. Can you review Tomás's findings and the fix PR once it's up? Ideally by end of day tomorrow.

Yes, I'll take it. The key check happens after the insert commits, so two in-flight requests can both pass it. We need a unique constraint on (tenant_id, idempotency_key). Tomás, add me as reviewer on the PR.
👍 will do
Unrelated: team lunch Thursday after the release? I'm thinking ramen at Kokoro.
In. But only if the release is actually done by then 😅
In, unless I'm on calls with Acme all day.

Acme update: I told their controller we've found the cause and will share a fix ETA tomorrow. They want the 37 duplicates voided on our side. Can someone confirm that voiding doesn't send a credit note email to their customers?
Voiding sends a credit note email by default. The admin script has a suppress_notifications flag. I'll void them tonight with that flag on.
Voided all 37 Acme duplicates with notifications suppressed. Sent Jenna the list of invoice numbers.
Thank you! Forwarding to Acme now.
Fix PR is up: #4821 "Enforce unique (tenant_id, idempotency_key) on invoices". Added Alex as reviewer.
Backfill PR #4818 is up. Ran it on staging-eu: the Acme-sized tenant finished in 41 min, no lock waits above 200ms.
Nice. Does it resume if the pod restarts halfway through?
Yes, it checkpoints the last processed id after every batch.

Reviewed #4821. The logic is right, but adding the unique index on invoices in prod will hit the same lock problem as Marcus's migration. It needs CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, and we have to dedupe existing rows first or the index build fails.
Good catch. There are 212 existing duplicate pairs across all tenants. I'll add a dedupe step before the index.
So do both fixes ship in 4.12, or do we split them?
My vote: ship the index fix as a hotfix ASAP since Acme is still getting duplicates, and keep the backfill for the Thursday release.
Agreed. Decision: #4821 goes out as hotfix 4.11.3 once Alex approves; #4818 stays in 4.12 on Thursday.
Updated #4821 with the dedupe step and a concurrent index build. Re-requested review.
Reminder: I'm on call from tonight through Friday. For anything after 6pm, page me, don't DM.
Approved #4821. Hannah, it's yours for the hotfix deploy whenever you're ready.
Hotfix 4.11.3 deployed to prod at 07:30. Dedupe removed 212 pairs, the index built in 9 min, no errors.
Acme confirms no new duplicates since 07:30 🎉 Their controller is asking for a written incident summary by Friday.
@Alex Wong can you write the incident summary for Acme? You know the root cause best. Please get a draft to me by Thursday EOD so I can review it before it goes out Friday.

Bad news on the release side: the #4818 backfill failed on staging-us overnight. One tenant has invoice rows with NULL tenant_id from a 2021 legacy import, the batch query skipped them and the verification step failed.
How many rows?
3,412 rows, all from one tenant (Brightline).
Can we fix the data in time, or does this push 4.12?
I can backfill tenant_id from the parent account, but I want Hannah to review the SQL before we touch prod. Realistically that's a day.
Ok. Decision: 4.12 moves from Thursday 10/23 to Monday 10/27. I'll tell support and update the release calendar.
Makes sense. I'll update the date on the customer-facing changelog.
So Thursday lunch is back on since we're not releasing 😄 Kokoro at 12:15, I booked a table for 6.
Perfect, I'll be there.
Anyone else coming? I need a final headcount by tonight.

messages.text:
Hi Alex,

Following up on last week's kickoff, here is the proposed cutover plan for moving Ledgerline's billing data to Northwind:

1. Write freeze on the old system: Friday Oct 31, 18:00 PT
2. Migration runs over the weekend (Nov 1-2)
3. Go-live: Monday Nov 3, 08:00 PT

What we need from you:
- Confirm the freeze window works for your team
- List of integrations that need to be repointed to Northwind
- UAT sign-off by Friday Oct 24, so we have a week of buffer

Happy to walk through it on a call if that's easier.

Best,
Rachel

Hi Rachel,

Thanks, this is clear. The freeze window works for engineering in principle.

Integrations to repoint: Stripe webhooks, the NetSuite sync, and Okta SCIM provisioning.

One concern: our month-end close runs Oct 31 to Nov 2, which overlaps the freeze. Finance will need at least read access during that window. I'll loop in Ben from finance to confirm exactly what they need.
+1 to Alex. Adding Ben. Ben, can you confirm what finance needs from the old system during close?

Hi all,

During close we need read-only access to AR aging and invoice exports until Nov 3 at noon. The write freeze itself is fine for us. If we lose read access over that weekend, close slips by two business days.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Ben, that's doable. We'll keep the old instance running in read-only mode until Nov 4, so AR aging and exports stay available through close. One caveat: exports from the old instance won't include anything entered in Northwind after go-live.

Hi Alex,

I ran the test migration on your Oct 10 snapshot. 1.92M records migrated, 2,406 failed validation. Almost all failures are the custom field "PO Reference": your values go up to 140 characters and our field is capped at 64.

Options:
(a) truncate to 64 characters during migration
(b) we extend the field to 255 characters, which is a $1,800 one-time change fee
(c) your team cleans the data before cutover

Let us know which way you want to go. Full failure report attached.

Omar

Thanks Omar. Truncation is not acceptable, our customers' AP systems match payments on the full PO reference. Cleaning 2,400 records by hand isn't realistic before Oct 31 either.

I'm leaning towards (b). Ben, is $1,800 OK to come out of the migration budget?
Approved, $1,800 from the migration budget line. Rachel, please send a change order so I can raise the PO.

Change order CO-0147 attached: field extension for PO Reference, $1,800. It needs a signature from someone with signing authority on your side. Lisa, is that you?

The UAT environment with the extended field will be ready Monday Oct 20.
UAT access works, thanks. Two of our engineers and Ben's team are testing this week. We'll send findings as we go and aim to sign off by the 24th.

Hi Alex,

Re-ran the migration on the Oct 20 snapshot with the extended field in UAT: 1.94M records migrated, 0 PO Reference failures.

37 customer records now fail on duplicate email addresses (same email, different customer IDs). List attached. We need a decision from your side for each: merge them into one customer, or keep them separate and we relax the uniqueness rule for your tenant.

Omar

Hi Alex, Lisa,

Friendly reminder that UAT sign-off is due this Friday, Oct 24. We still don't have CO-0147 signed, and without it Omar can't apply the field change to production.

Alex, can you confirm who is signing, and give us your call on the 37 duplicate customers by Thursday Oct 23? Otherwise the Oct 31 freeze date is at risk.

Thanks,
Rachel

Signed CO-0147 this morning, attached.

Alex, please make the call on the 37 duplicates together with Ben. Finance cares about which customer record keeps the AR history, so check with him before you reply to Omar.
